name: Differential Growth
desc: A closed sumi-ink contour repels and subdivides itself into ever-tightening coral brain-folds on toned paper, regrowing from a seed ring every arc.

density.doc: target node count -> fold complexity (70..240 nodes)

scale.doc: overall size of the growing curve

fold.doc: fold tightness: high = smaller spacing, denser convolutions

style.doc: aesthetic: brushed sumi ink w/ bleed on toned paper / white schematic contour + node ticks on cyanotype (abstract) / additive glowing neon line / false-color heat-ramp segments (abstract)

act.doc: grow = steady growth then regrow each ~34s arc / pulse = growth rate swells with the section intensity
